visualCharacteristics.purpose: Three equal columns, each a short heading/label followed by a bulleted list or an image; stacks on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: Existing columns variants are 2-column asymmetric layouts (columns-intro-box copy | grey callout; columns-media copy | image; columns-intro-video copy | video). This is 3 equal text-only columns (heading + list), under 80% similar. | Same 3 equal columns, short heading-like label + content below, no box/callout. An image instead of a list is a content difference the block handles.

contentPattern.summary: 3 fixed columns, each an h4 module title + bulleted list (Bioreactor / Cell Count and Viability / Titer) | 3 labelled views side by side: 'Front View', 'Side View', 'Front View Open', each with a zoomable image
contentPattern.structure: one row, three cells: heading + bulleted list, or label + image

reuseGuidance: Use for module / feature lists and labelled technical views. For 2-column layouts use columns-media.
